My publication record is centered on physics-based damage modeling for advanced high-strength steels. A complete and up-to-date list is also available on [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.ca/citations?user=zI0fpEwAAAAJ).

## Research Direction

::: {.pub-entry}
**Physics informed machine learning for forming limit prediction**

Current work connecting crystallographic descriptors, constitutive response, and strain path with DeepONet and other ML ready forming limit workflows.
:::
